problem: Excavator operators are scarce and sites are unsafe. Contractors want to run several machines remotely and eventually have them operate autonomously.
business_model: Hardware retrofit kit plus remote operation software, with collected data used to train autonomous policies (pricing not public)
product_category: Construction robotics, teleoperation and autonomy retrofit

founders.name: Jash Mota
previous_startups: Remote teleoperation tool used by companies including Accenture (per YC launch post)

founders.name: Mahimana Bhatt
founders.background_notes: Built the data and ML pipeline at Motional per YC launch post. Education not found.

competitors.name: Built Robotics
competitors.what: Exosystem retrofit kit for unmanned excavators

competitors.name: AIM Intelligent Machines
competitors.what: Retrofits bulldozers and excavators to run autonomously

technical_complexity.rationale: Low latency teleoperation over cellular networks, machine agnostic hydraulic retrofit and later learned autonomy policies are hard for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Well funded rivals were already building retrofit autonomy. Data from teleoperated jobsites could compound, but the team was two people with little traction disclosed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition of Flywheel found. Well funded rivals such as Bedrock raised large rounds in 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: Construction labor shortages and site safety concerns, plus a wave of 2025 funding for excavator autonomy startups, showed demand and investor interest.

branding.domain_note: Uses useflywheel.ai, a prefix on a .ai domain

identity.visual_style: Bold all caps headlines on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Safety and productivity focused, plus the pitch Waymo for excavators

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN post and a remote controlled excavator brought to Demo Day (Lobster Capital podcast episode); open sourced 100 hours of excavator data per one report

brand_strength.rationale: Name is shared with several other Flywheel companies, search results mix them up. The Waymo for excavators line is memorable but brand coverage is thin.

outcome_analysis: Flywheel AI is a two person YC Summer 2025 company that retrofits excavators for remote operation and plans to train autonomy from the data. It is still early with no exit. The space drew large funding for rivals like Bedrock, Gravis and TerraFirma, so the risk is being outspent, while the remote first approach may give faster revenue than full autonomy.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, PitchBook, FundedIQ, Preqin) report a roughly $500K pre-seed in September 2025 with YC and Pioneer Fund, other investors listed by PitchBook. No company announcement or press release found, so this is unverified and not recorded as a round. One aggregator dates a seed to January 2025, which conflicts. Competitors Gravis and TerraFirma raised large rounds later and are omitted from the as-of list. Website Contact button links to teleo.ai. Completeness pass: the $500K pre-seed of 2025-09 is recorded from VCBacked and FundedIQ (aggregators only; neuronfeed dates a seed 2025-01, conflicting). No press found; Pioneer Fund investment not confirmed outside databases.
